name: Mizuna harvest · exploratory ridge
validation: Nested 4-fold GroupKFold, paired pillow numbers kept together; inner 3-fold alpha search. One experiment only; folds do not establish cross-study generalization.

interval.kind: 90th percentile absolute outer-CV residual, uncalibrated descriptive range

limitations: Only 14 measured harvest outcomes from VEG04A; not validated for another experiment or spacecraft.
Crop is mizuna, not lettuce, tomato or radish. No cross-crop prediction.
Full-period irrigation is a retrospective input; this is not an early harvest forecast or causal irrigation recommendation.
Irrigation supplied is not physiological water demand or transpiration.
Small-data regression may underperform its baseline; see measured metrics.
No gravity-dose, radiation, temperature or humidity treatment effects can be learned from these tables.
